summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The SEI Ang Research Enhanced U.S. Large Cap ETF (ANGU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund tracks an index of US large-cap equities selected through an optimization process that uses a dynamic multi-factor score and multiple constraints. The fund weighs its four factors using three models: (50%) market similarity, (25%) factor momentum, and (25%) factor of factors ANGU was launched on Aug 6, 2026 and is issued by SEI.
